Overview

Support Services, explained

When technology stops working, your team stops working. You need help fast, from people who already know your setup.

Our helpdesk runs 24/7 with an average response under 15 minutes. We manage users, devices and updates, and your account manager makes sure everything is coordinated.

  • Businesses with staff in different time zones
  • Teams tired of waiting for support

How it works

From first call to done, in four steps

  1. Review

    We check your systems, backups and security against best practice.

  2. Fixed quote

    A clear scope for what we'll manage and how.

  3. Onboard & harden

    Monitoring, patching and security controls put in place.

  4. Monitor & support

    24/7 monitoring and helpdesk, with regular reports.

Pricing

What affects the cost of Support Services

  • Number of users, devices and servers
  • Whether systems are on-premise, in the cloud, or both
  • The level of monitoring and response you need
  • Backup and recovery requirements
  • Security standards you need to meet, such as the Essential Eight

Every quote is itemised, in AUD or USD, and valid for 30 days.

Get a fixed quote

Getting started

What we'll need from you

  • A list of your systems, servers and key software
  • Admin access so we can review your setup
  • Any recent incidents or problems
  • Who in your team we should contact for approvals

Don't have all of this yet? That's fine. We'll work through it together in your free consultation.

FAQ

Support Services questions

Is support really 24/7?

Yes. Our helpdesk runs around the clock.

Do you support clients outside Australia?

Yes. Support is delivered remotely, in English.

How do we contact support?

By phone or email, any time.

Do you support Mac and Windows?

Ask us about your mix of devices and we'll confirm coverage.

Can you work with our existing IT person?

Yes. We can support them or take over day-to-day support.

Is support remote or on-site?

Most support is remote. On-site needs can be discussed in your quote.

Do you support home workers?

Yes, wherever your team works.

Can we get reports on support requests?

Yes, monthly.
